$comment: Machine-readable capability status. Every level below was established by running the referenced command in this repository. Entries not personally re-verified in a session carry verificationLevel 'unaudited' rather than an optimistic guess. Markdown must not contradict this file.

levelDefinitions.not_implemented: No working code path. Entry points must return blocked/not_implemented.
levelDefinitions.unaudited: Code exists but was not verified in this session. Do not cite as evidence.
levelDefinitions.offline_verified: Deterministic behaviour proven by the test suite; no model or Harmony.
levelDefinitions.real_model_verified: Executed against real model weights producing real artifacts.
levelDefinitions.real_harmony_smoke_verified: One successful operation against a licensed Harmony with evidence.
levelDefinitions.shot_verified: A complete shot was produced, rendered, reviewed and approved.

knownFailures: Single-person only: pose runs on the highest-scoring detection; multi-person tracking is not implemented.
No temporal smoothing; per-frame video use will jitter.
Validated on one photographic fixture only; stylised/animated line art is unvalidated.
capabilities.nextRequiredProof: Run across a real video sequence and measure temporal stability; validate on genuine animation line art rather than a photograph.

knownFailures: Acceptance test (wrist moves relative to shoulder) has NEVER run: no real arm-raise footage exists locally.
Validated only on synthetic camera motion over a still photograph; no real subject motion.
p95 jitter increased 8.20 -> 17.76 px/frame after One Euro filtering; the adaptive cutoff overshoots at direction changes under strong camera motion.
Single person only. Identity is IoU + pose similarity, not tracking.
No occlusion, lighting or multi-subject robustness data.
capabilities.blockingReason: Real arm-raise video absent. All 71 mp4 files under output/ are fabricated ASCII placeholders; no usable clip ships with any dependency. See fixtures/video/README.md.
capabilities.nextRequiredProof: Place fixtures/video/arm_raise.mp4 and pass test_wrist_moves_relative_to_shoulder_on_real_arm_raise. Only then may this become real_model_verified.

knownFailures: Bezier control points come from a tangent heuristic, not a least-squares (Schneider) fit; curve fidelity is unmeasured.
capabilities.blockingReason: Not audited in any session so far. Zhang-Suen thinning plus cubic Bezier fitting is present and reads correctly, but no run was executed and curve fidelity against a source centerline has never been measured, so no level above unaudited can be claimed.
capabilities.nextRequiredProof: Measure max deviation between fitted curves and the source centerline on a real drawing; the preliminary claim that this produced 'broken polygons' was NOT reproduced — Zhang-Suen thinning plus cubic Bezier fitting is present.

capabilities.blockingReason: Not started. Deliberately deferred: building a shot factory on top of a perception layer that fabricated keypoints would have industrialised a false result.
capabilities.nextRequiredProof: ShotManifest schema, deterministic compiler and an offline golden-path bundle.

knownFailures: Single-person only. With several people the highest-IoU detection wins and identity can swap silently.
capabilities.blockingReason: Recorded capability gap for Sprint 1. Deliberately deferred; LocoTrack not integrated.
capabilities.nextRequiredProof: Multi-person association with stable IDs measured on footage containing at least two people.

knownFailures: Fabrication detection is heuristic: it flags small printable-ASCII media containing known placeholder markers. A large or binary fake would not be caught.
The evidence gate only enforces bundles under docs/evidence; output/ is reported as a warning because it is gitignored scratch.
Gates check that evidence exists and hashes match; they cannot judge whether the evidence supports the claim.
capabilities.nextRequiredProof: Run the gates in CI against a real runner; CI has never executed on this repository (0 of 13 historical runs started a job).
